newsitem.title: CHINA: China cuts express mail price for HK handover.
newsitem.headline: China cuts express mail price for HK handover.

text.p: China will slash the price of express delivery services between the mainland and Hong Kong by 30 percent to celebrate Beijing's resumption of sovereignty over Hong Kong on July 1, officials said on Thursday.

More than 10 cities in the mainland including Beijing, Shanghai and southern Guangzhou and Shenzhen, will benefit from the lower price from June 16 to August 15, said an official of the China Directory General of Posts.
"We want to make contributions to Hong Kong's return," the official said.
Postal departments in the mainland and Hong Kong would cooperate to promote the speed of express delivery services during the handover period, he said, but gave no further details.
